name: one contrast frame in a 150-word human comment is still above the human maximum
text: I have used both editors for years and switched back twice. It's not about the brace format, it's about whether the team agrees on one. We picked the formatter that shipped with the language and stopped arguing about it in review. The build checks it now, so nobody has to remember. New hires get the same setup on day one, and pull requests stopped carrying whitespace changes. The only real cost was one afternoon of churn when we reformatted the whole repository at once, and we did it on a Friday so it would not collide with feature work. Since then the review comments have been about behaviour, naming, and tests, which is what we wanted from review in the first place. If a project of ours does not use a formatter yet, I would set one up before the codebase grows past a few thousand lines.
